title: A page item that names a PR quotes the PR's own title and files
why: Incident 12:00 CST Nov 13: item 721 said PR #1779 fixes child repos' pages; it changes two claude-settings scripts. The owner picked a on the wrong text; runner 11 asked what #1779 was and I read the PR.
note: Todo. Add a check in the waiting-page skill (or a page-item lint) that an item naming a PR number carries that PR's title and changed files, read from GitHub when the item is posted. Triage reads the PR before posting, not the ledger line.
